atlases.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / identity-preserving animation asset authoring. Input image 1 is the newly rendered full-body cartoon wrestler REFERENCE AND EDIT TARGET. Make exactly ONE production animation layer ATLAS for this EXACT character, preserving her exact face identity, costume, colors, cel shading and pose. This is not a character collage. It contains exactly SIX DISJOINT ISOLATED TRANSPARENT PARTS, never a whole assembled person. Canvas landscape 3:2, strict equal 3-column by 2-row invisible grid. Each part is centered inside its own cell with 8% clear alpha margin, each part fills cell reasonably. No gridlines, labels, text, boxes, floor, gradient, glow, shadows, extra cutouts, complete character, props. Genuine transparent alpha around and between all pieces. Preserve ink contours and paint the hidden overlap areas at joints so they can animate. Parts must combine into the same reference character in the same standing posture.
Top-left cell: BODY layer. Entire sports-shirt torso with natural shoulders' attachment sockets, pelvis, both complete legs, knee pads and both boots. NO head, NO hair, NO arms/hands. Include a short collar/neck base stub for overlap; reconstruct obscured torso where arms/hair covered it. Top-middle cell: HEAD layer. Exact clean readable face, both ears, full forehead, head shape and neck; NO external hair, crown hair or fringe, no shoulders or torso. Keep actual facial likeness and clear eyes/eyebrows/mouth. A clean head ready to be overlapped by hair layers. Top-right cell: BACK HAIR layer only, exact entire rear hair silhouette as coherent hair mass behind head, down to same length as reference, no face, body or arms. Bottom-left cell: FRONT HAIR layer only, exact crown and bangs/fringe and front side locks; include reference head accessory/beret if any as part of this layer, no face, head skin, torso, arms. Bottom-middle cell: the arm on the LEFT SIDE OF THE PICTURE: shoulder, upper arm, elbow, forearm, gloves/wraps and hand, complete from shoulder to fingertips, same bent/straight position and gear as reference. No torso or hair; extend shoulder by small round overlap tab for animation. Bottom-right cell: the arm on the RIGHT SIDE OF THE PICTURE, same full limb with correct gear and overlap tab. No torso/hair. All six cells are separated. A professional 2D skeletal animation parts atlas, precise matte edges. Bold clear anime cartoon lineart and sharp two-band cel shadows; not photorealistic.
Character identity reminder: Character RAVEN: closely follow the reference's long straight deep crimson hair, long side fringe partially covering one eye but leave both eyes readable for animation, sharp pale grey eyes and stern confident mature face, fair skin and strong athletic proportions. Keep the reference's black cropped sleeveless athletic top and fitted dark navy full-length wrestling leggings, add practical black crimson wrestling boots and fingerless gloves. Signature personality relentless pressure striker. Both hands in a low guarded loose-fist pose, visible muscular shoulders, long hair falls separately down both sides. Black/navy/crimson color palette. No pointing at camera; puppet-ready balanced stance.
